def choose_move(observation):
    agent_state = observation.get('agent', {})
    position = agent_state.get('position', (0, 0))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])
    # Combine all potential targets: resources, enemies, border
    targets = resources + enemies + border
    if targets:
        # Find the closest target based on Manhattan distance
        target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-position[0]) + abs(t[1]-position[1]))
        dx = target[0] - position[0]
        dy = target[1] - position[1]
        # Normalize move to -1, 0, or 1
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Default move when no targets: stay put or move arbitrarily
        return [0, 0]
